calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

calls.statement:
-- Check staff purchase proportion at Pitäjänmäki in period 5
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag = TRUE THEN 'Staff purchases' ELSE 'Regular sales' END as sale_type,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 102 
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY f.staff_purchase_flag
